summary: Focused regression + new-feature tests for Score Change Alerts (notifications) and Downloadable Score Report (PDF + /verify). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 46 → 52 tests. Backend: 51 pass, 1 skipped (score-event→notification test skipped only when run in parallel with the eval-write already happening in the same quarter via another worker; when run in isolation it passes and I verified [MOCK EMAIL] log line 'Your EIBIL score increased by 8 points' is written to /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log). Frontend: /verify public page works (invalid, valid, lowercase code), nav-verify link in header, employee notification bell shows dropdown with 6 items (unread badge auto-hidden when count=0), mark-all-read conditionally rendered only when unread>0 (correct), notification-view-all link present, score-alerts-panel with score-alert-item rows renders on employee dashboard, download-report button returns a valid PDF (magic %PDF). Each PDF download creates a new unique EIB-XXXX-XXXX code (verified via regex on PDF bytes). Public verify endpoint returns authentic+score+dimensions+employment+ledgerValid. Employer portal regression still loads.

issues: Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' logged on initial render — cosmetic console warning only, chart renders correctly after layout. Consider setting a minHeight on the ResponsiveContainer parent.

critical_code_review_comments: notificationService.markRead: when called with no id it marks ALL unread as read for that user — behaves correctly per spec, but there is no response payload (ok(res, null)); consider returning {updated: n} so the frontend can confirm.

reportService.pdf: creates a new VerificationCheck row on every /employee/report.pdf call → each click generates a new EIB code. This is per spec but produces unbounded growth; consider pruning or capping active codes per employee, and/or marking old self-report codes revoked once a newer one is generated.

scoreEventService: email threshold default 1 (via cfg.events.notifyThreshold || 1) — the problem statement says default 3. Verify that score-config seed actually sets events.notifyThreshold=3; otherwise every tiny delta spams email. In my test an |delta|=8 did fire email (expected), but code path uses || which also means a seeded value of 0 would be ignored.

VerifyReport.jsx CodeForm: uppercases the entered code before navigating; good. But the input strips nothing else — users pasting with surrounding spaces trim is handled, however stripping of embedded whitespace or dashes isn't. publicVerify matches raw+raw.toUpperCase() only, so 'eib 7nxl ayg7' or 'EIB7NXLAYG7' would fail. Low priority.
NotificationBell toggle(): fetches notifications on open but doesn't refetch on subsequent opens — stale list until pathname changes. Low priority.

success_rate.backend: 100% (51/51 run, 1 skipped due to quarter-eval dedup in parallel scheduling; passes stand-alone)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - all required data-testids present and flows working end-to-end
